pageHeadHtml:
Selected Talks

A concise selection of scientific presentations and invited discussions most closely related to my current work.
pageBodyHtml:
Scientific presentations

  • RSNA 2025, Chicago. Cutting-Edge scientific presentation: Radiology's Last Exam (RadLE 1.0).
  • MICCAI 2025, Daejeon. Oral presentation: “Fine-grained rib fracture diagnosis with hyperbolic embeddings.” Preprint →
  • RSNA 2023, Chicago. Trainee Research Prize presentation for AIRib; two Cutting-Edge oral presentations on LLM-augmented radiology reporting; and an educational exhibit on AI in interventional radiology.
  • International Skeletal Society 2023, London. Digital poster on AI in musculoskeletal interventions.

Invited talks and panels

  • 2026 — GLC4HSR Annual Conclave, Indian National Science Academy. Panel on digital health transformation and data governance. Programme →
  • 2026 — National Conference on AI in Health Care and Education, IMS-BHU. Invited talk: “Beyond Human Diagnostics: Road to Medical Super Intelligence.” Programme →
  • 2025 — AOCR / IRIA Annual Congress. Faculty talks, workshops and panels on AI and clinical radiology. Congress →
  • 2025 — La French Tech India AI Summit. Panel on responsible AI. Event →
  • 2024 — NASSCOM Future Forge. HealthTech roundtable keynote.
For speaking enquiries, email suvrankar.datta@ashoka.edu.in.
